_comment: Development-only behavioural cases for prune-comments. Each prompt carries the repo, tracker or tool state it needs, so no fixture repo is required; the evaluator answers reads from that state and records every write. Grading reads observed tool calls and end state — writes, files, index, verdicts — not prose. Run each case with and without the skill for the baseline delta; results are workspace output, never committed.

evals.prompt: Clean up the pointless comments in src/sync.ts. (State: line 12 '// increment the retry counter' sits above `retries += 1`. Line 40 '// wait for the SDK to settle' sits above `await sleep(250)` right after `client.reconnect()`; the sleep works around the upstream SDK dropping writes issued within 200 ms of a reconnect, and this comment is the only marker in the repo that the sleep is deliberate.)
evals.expected_output: Line 12 is a restatement and is offered for removal with its code line. Line 40 looks just as plain but is the only trace of a workaround, so it is protected: not listed, not removed. On confirmation only line 12's comment goes, and no code line changes.
expectations: Line 12 is listed as a restatement candidate together with its code line.
Line 40's comment is not listed as a candidate and is still present after the run.
After confirmation, the diff removes only line 12's comment and changes no code line.
The repo's check command runs after the edit, and no commit or push is made.
